\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Near the first resonance
\begin{equation}
T(\omega) = \frac{1}{1+x^2}, \quad x = \frac{\omega-\epsilon_1}{\Gamma_1} .
\label{eq:t1}
\end{equation}
and near the second
\begin{equation}
T(\omega) = \frac{1}{x^2+1}, \quad x = \frac{\omega-\epsilon_2}{\Gamma_2} .
\label{eq:t2}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
